SELECT 
	SaleLedgerLogID=99999999999,
	itemname= case item.printable WHEN 1 THEN item.name ELSE 'Counter Sale:'+LTRIM(RTRIM(item.customicode)) END, 
	aliasname=item.customicode,
	accname = dbo.accounts.name, 
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc, 
	address = dbo.customer.address1,
	machine = dbo.saleledger.machinename,
	salesman = CASE WHEN dbo.saleledger.Modifycounter > 0 THEN (SELECT u.username FROM dbo.users u WHERE u.UserCode = dbo.saleledger.ModifiedBy) ELSE dbo.users.username END, 
	headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,
	saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	date = dbo.saleledger.date,   
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	remarks = dbo.saleledger.remarks,   
	dbo.saleledger.custcode, 
	gcode = saledetail.gcode,   
	icode = saledetail.icode,   
	batch = saledetail.batch,   
	expiry = saledetail.expiry,   
	looseqty = saledetail.looseqty,
	bonusqty = saledetail.bonusqty,
	packqty  = saledetail.packqty,
	packunits= saledetail.packunits,
	saleprice= saledetail.saleprice,
	itemflatdisc=saledetail.itemflatdisc,  
	discperc = saledetail.discperc,
	salestax = saledetail.salestax,
	ID=dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL  ,
	unitsalestax  = saledetail.unitsalestax,
	gstperc       = saledetail.gstperc,
	invgstperc    = saleledger.invgstperc1 ,
	printwaranty=dbo.saleledger.printwaranty,
	printbatch=dbo.saleledger.printbatch,
	reprintcounter=saleledger.reprintingcounter,
	serverdate=getdate(),
	messagedesc=(select description from message where messagecode=saleledger.messagecode),
	salesperson=(select name from salesman where salesmancode=saleledger.smancode),
	modifycounter=ISNULL(dbo.saleledger.modifycounter, 0)

FROM 
	saleledger,  
	saledetail, 
	accounts, 
	customer,
	users, 
	item  

WHERE ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ar_SaleInvCode ) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
	( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode) AND 
	( dbo.saledetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	SaleLedgerLogID=SaleledgerLog.SaleLedgerLogID,
	itemname= case item.printable WHEN 1 THEN item.name ELSE 'Counter Sale:'+LTRIM(RTRIM(item.customicode)) END, 
	aliasname=item.customicode,
	accname = dbo.accounts.name, 
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc, 
	address = dbo.customer.address1,
	machine = dbo.saleledgerlog.machinename,
	salesman = CASE WHEN dbo.saleledgerlog.Modifycounter > 0 THEN (SELECT u.username FROM dbo.users u WHERE u.UserCode = dbo.saleledgerlog.ModifiedBy) ELSE dbo.users.username END, 
	headerno = dbo.saleledgerlog.headerno,
	saleinvcode = dbo.saleledgerlog.saleinvcode,   
	date = dbo.saleledgerlog.date,   
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledgerlog.discperc,   
	misccharges = dbo.saleledgerlog.misccharges,   
	flatdisc = dbo.saleledgerlog.flatdisc,   
	invsalestax = dbo.saleledgerlog.salestax,   
	remarks = dbo.saleledgerlog.remarks,   
	dbo.saleledgerlog.custcode, 
	gcode = saledetaillog.gcode,   
	icode = saledetaillog.icode,   
	batch = saledetaillog.batch,   
	expiry = saledetaillog.expiry,   
	looseqty = saledetaillog.looseqty,
	bonusqty = saledetaillog.bonusqty,
	packqty  = saledetaillog.packqty,
	packunits= saledetaillog.packunits,
	saleprice= saledetaillog.saleprice,
	itemflatdisc=saledetaillog.itemflatdisc,  
	discperc = saledetaillog.discperc,
	salestax = saledetaillog.salestax,
	ID=dbo.saledetaillog.RowID,
	unitsalestax  = saledetaillog.unitsalestax,
	gstperc       = saledetaillog.gstperc,
	invgstperc    = saleledgerlog.invgstperc1 ,
	printwaranty=dbo.saleledgerlog.printwaranty,
	printbatch=dbo.saleledgerlog.printbatch,
	reprintcounter=saleledgerlog.reprintingcounter,
	serverdate=getdate(),
	messagedesc=(select description from message where messagecode=saleledgerlog.messagecode),
	salesperson=(select name from salesman where salesmancode=saleledgerlog.smancode),
	modifycounter=ISNULL(dbo.saleledgerlog.modifycounter, 0)

FROM saleledgerlog, 
	saledetaillog, 
	accounts, 
	customer,
	users, 
	item  

WHERE ( dbo.saleledgerlog.saleinvcode = :ar_SaleInvCode ) AND
	( dbo.saleledgerLog.saleledgerlogid = dbo.saledetailLog.saleledgerlogid) AND 
	( dbo.saleledgerlog.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetaillog.saleinvcode) AND
	( dbo.saleledgerlog.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
	( dbo.saleledgerlog.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode) AND 
	( dbo.saledetaillog.icode = dbo.item.icode)

ORDER BY 
	SaleLedgerLogID,
	saleinvcode,
	ID

objects.name: c_salestaxval
objects.expression: round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+ bonusqty)* unitsalestax ,2)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.visible: 1	if(count(id for group 1) = cumulativeSum( 1 for group 1), 1, 0)
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1 ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1 ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for group 1) , 0)

objects.name: compute_5
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1)

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: Sum((  looseqty   *  ( saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) for group 1)
